root_review.meaning: Root compared all 11 source/output pairs. Two identified residual-flow issues (tower-upstream right branch and Menqian-middle transverse tributary) received targeted repair and root recheck. This does not certify real hidden geology or user approval.

method: Built-in image_gen local patch edit, then exact source retention outside an explicit fluid mask. Replacement bed is a synthetic hypothesis, not recovered ground truth.
generation_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this crop of a real fixed surveillance view of a braided grey shale gully. Remove ALL visible pale yellow/tan moving muddy liquid, including the small whitish fluid branch at left center. Replace ONLY liquid with a plausible dry grey angular shale gravel bed matching the adjacent exposed original gravel islands. Keep every already exposed grey gravel island, larger real rock, eroded bank, road at right, cliff and perspective exactly aligned. No new large boulders. Natural irregular granular texture at the existing scale, smaller in the distance; no repetitive stipples, worm patterns, furrows, swirls or tiling. The dry bed should look like the grey adjacent banks, with subdued fine gravel and a few sparse small stones, not beige fluid. NO water, wet sheen, mud waves, foam or puddles. Preserve all white camera labels exactly. Same exact crop geometry and scale, no zoom, no lens change, no added objects. This is a proposed synthetic dry-bed fill, not scientific recovery of the hidden bed.
limitations: The generated hidden riverbed is an unverified synthetic hypothesis, not recovered original geology.
An explicit assistant-estimated fluid mask is used; preserving pixels outside it is a necessary constraint, not proof that the full mask is semantically correct.
Static video repeats one image and contains no observed physical time or flow.
Synthetic fine gravel is somewhat uniform; user should assess naturalness.
assistant_visual_review: Full-frame source/mask/composite comparison inspected. Original landscape retained outside the explicit mask. Candidate for user content review, not user acceptance.
